explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the final judge over all people, both living and dead.
Persecution or pain that believers may experience for their faith, which should not be a reason to feel ashamed.
The act by which God calls the chosen ones out of the power of sin and gives them new life in Christ.
The period when God's judgment on the world is approaching, requiring believers to live with clarity and self-control.
The act where believers use their gifts to serve others in a way that honors God.
The concept of being willing to suffer for the sake of righteousness, which is better than living in fear of human wrath.
